All 26 backend tests pass, all frontend flows verified.

minor.issue: The media streaming endpoint is defined without the /api prefix and is NOT routed through the Kubernetes ingress public URL (only /api/* paths reach backend port 8001). The endpoint code itself is correct with Range support, but the public URL returns frontend HTML for /uploads/media/ paths. This would require nginx/ingress to also proxy /uploads/* to port 8001, or move the endpoint under /api/uploads/media/.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 3 features verified and passing: Analytics dashboard (charts with empty state), CVR 3-section UI (Recordings/Hours Requests/Storage Config), CVR storage config persistence, hours requests full CRUD workflow, channel edit form fix verified (quality_label/channel_type/stream_url preserved), branding service name update, settings tab loads cleanly. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py cover all new API endpoints. One minor issue: /uploads/media/ isn't accessible via public URL (no /api prefix on streaming endpoint). TEST_ prefixed hours requests were created during testing and remain in DB.

Media Streaming Public URL.root_cause: The /uploads/media/{filename} endpoint in server.py is defined without the /api prefix. Kubernetes ingress only routes /api/* paths to backend port 8001. Frontend routes (no /api prefix) go to port 3000. Therefore /uploads/media/ is served by the React SPA which returns HTML (200) instead of media files.
Media Streaming Public URL.reproduction: Request https://epg-test.preview.emergentagent.com/uploads/media/any.mp4 - returns 200 with HTML content type (frontend SPA response) instead of 404/streaming from backend.
Media Streaming Public URL.mitigation: Option 1: Move endpoint to /api/uploads/media/{filename} and update any frontend media URLs accordingly. Option 2: Add Kubernetes ingress rule to route /uploads/* to port 8001.
